capabilities: Edit .py and .pyi files with CodeMirror 6 syntax highlighting and line numbers
Navigate an outline of classes, functions, methods, and the __main__ entry point
Search and replace within files via Ctrl/Cmd+F and Ctrl/Cmd+H
Fold code, match brackets, and undo/redo edits
Save changes automatically through Obsidian's TextFileView lifecycle
disambiguation: Not a Python runner; it edits .py source as text and never executes the code.
extras: States twice that Python code is never executed by the plugin, and notes mobile compatibility with no Node.js or Electron APIs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit Python source files stored in the vault.
summary: Code editor that opens and edits .py and .pyi files inside Obsidian with Python syntax highlighting, an outline, search/replace, and auto-save.
